name: Exec Cluster Cost: IB Equity — PerShare Commission + SpreadBased Slippage
description: Tests: PerShare commission ($0.005/share, $1 min, 0.5% max) + SpreadBased slippage. Run with --cost ib_equity
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: Interactive Brokers Equity Commission
# Run with: --cost ib_equity --cash 100000
# Validates: PerShare commission with min/max, SpreadBased slippage (ADV-tiered)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: Momentum top-K ===
mom = roc(period=63)(close)
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())
is_top = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=2)(mom)

enter = is_new_month and is_top
exit = is_new_month and not is_top
held = hold_until()(enter=enter, exit=exit)
weights = equal_weight()(active_mask=held)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=8)
